scope: Terra production execution record for the twelve designated regional Release Seed venues. Existing production records were not changed.

targets.name: 宇都宮市文化会館 大ホール
targets.firstPass: started: official one-page numbered PDF visually checked; floor totals shown as 1F 1370, 2F 430, 3F 200
targets.reason: Complete row/area transcription and independent extraction remain required; no number was inferred from the displayed floor totals.

targets.name: 仙台サンプラザホール
targets.firstPass: started: official vector PDF fetched and inspected; distinct F/L/C/R and floor zones retained for transcription
targets.reason: The official 2054 and 2372 totals describe different sightline availability; no selectable set was entered before every zone endpoint is independently verified.

targets.name: 札幌文化芸術劇場hitaru
targets.nominalSeatCount: 2302 A pattern; 2051 B pattern; 1686 C pattern
targets.reason: The official facility page expressly defines A/B/C usage patterns (2302/2051/1686) and up to 175 seats removed for orchestra-pit use. The record does not define one normal representative configuration.

targets.name: 梅田芸術劇場 メインホール
targets.firstPass: started: current and announced replacement official maps separated by effective date
targets.reason: The dated 1905-seat current map is valid on the review date, while a 1920-seat replacement takes effect shortly afterwards. Ranges must be committed only with an effective-date source update.

targets.name: 博多座
targets.firstPass: started: official theatre route resolved from the current site
targets.reason: The Release Seed root URL is not itself the seat-map artifact; the current theatre route requires complete numbered-map and capacity reconciliation before range entry.

targets.name: 横浜みなとみらいホール 大ホール
targets.firstPass: started: official three-floor vector PDF fetched for visual and text-coordinate review
targets.reason: The official map records non-numbered wheelchair spaces; the numbered collection must be fully transcribed without treating that nominal-capacity difference as a range adjustment.

targets.name: ミューザ川崎シンフォニーホール
targets.firstPass: started: official block map and its numbered block catalogue verified
targets.reason: A wheelchair position is identified within 2CA; complete row endpoints and its numbered/non-numbered treatment must be extracted rather than inferred.

targets.name: 所沢市民文化センター ミューズ アークホール
targets.firstPass: started: official map fetched and fixed/movable-seat statement checked
targets.reason: The capacity is stated as up to 2002 by use pattern. The normal numbered arrangement and the stated wheelchair-convertible seats require explicit map-level extraction.

targets.name: 札幌コンサートホールKitara 大ホール
targets.firstPass: started: official arena-style PDF fetched for vector and visual review
targets.reason: Floor and surrounding-block boundaries have not yet been independently transcribed; no total-fitting ranges were entered.

targets.name: 京都コンサートホール 大ホール
targets.firstPass: started: official January 2026 vector map visually checked; stated subtotals are 1F 980, 2F balcony 279/podium 174, 3F balcony 198/center 202
targets.reason: The numbered wheelchair-space distinction and all left/right/balcony/podium ranges still require an independent complete extraction.

targets.name: アクロス福岡 福岡シンフォニーホール
targets.firstPass: started: official vector PDF fetched and visually checked; diagram states 1F 1212, 2F 384, 3F 275 and 1871 numbered seats excluding four wheelchair spaces
targets.reason: The official diagram provides an explainable four-seat non-numbered difference, but each level's numbered ranges remain to be independently extracted.

targets.name: 御園座
targets.reason: The official page provides a standard map, a hanamichi map, and production-specific maps, and explicitly says seat classifications differ by performance. No single normal representative configuration is defined.
